notes: Toggle now has its own Style section and editor cadence family.
Renderer emits explicit toggle anatomy: native checkbox, switch track, thumb, optional on/off state text, visible label, data-eit-toggle-on-value, and screen-reader contract text.
Frontend semantics remain intentionally checked-only: checked sends the first option value, unchecked/reset sends no filter.
Guilherme owns visual/interaction QA for off/on clarity, label position, state text, focus, reset, URL restore, and mobile full-row behavior.
